classification.difficultyReason: The hardest diagram requires replacing a reflex central angle with its interior counterpart, recognising two tangent-radius right angles, and applying the quadrilateral angle sum.

content.prompt: Find the value of $a$ in these diagrams that include tangents.

spec.description: Triangle BOA with BA tangent at A, central angle 71° and unknown at B.
spec.mathematics: OA is a radius; angle BOA is 71°; angle OBA is a°.

answer.worked:
$\angle OAB=90^\circ$ because a tangent is perpendicular to the contact radius.
$$\begin{aligned}a+90^\circ+71^\circ&=180^\circ\\a&=19^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Vertical tangent AB, radius OA and segment OB; 28° leader points to B.
spec.mathematics: Angle OBA is 28° and angle BOA is a°.

answer.worked:
$\angle OAB=90^\circ$ because a tangent is perpendicular to the contact radius.
$$\begin{aligned}a+90^\circ+28^\circ&=180^\circ\\a&=62^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Tangent BA at lower-right A; 20° leader identifies the angle at external B.
spec.mathematics: Angle OBA is 20°; angle BOA is a°.

answer.worked:
$\angle OAB=90^\circ$ because a tangent is perpendicular to the contact radius.
$$\begin{aligned}a+90^\circ+20^\circ&=180^\circ\\a&=70^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Two tangents from P on the left, radii OA and OB, and leader to the 150° central angle.
spec.mathematics: Angle AOB is 150°; angle APB is a°.

answer.worked:
$\angle OAP=\angle OBP=90^\circ$ because tangents are perpendicular to the contact radii. The angles of quadrilateral $OAPB$ sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}a+90^\circ+150^\circ+90^\circ&=360^\circ\\a&=30^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Two tangents from P on the right, radii OA and OB, and leader to the 162° central angle.
spec.mathematics: Angle AOB is 162°; angle APB is a°.

answer.worked:
$\angle OAP=\angle OBP=90^\circ$ because tangents are perpendicular to the contact radii. The angles of quadrilateral $OAPB$ sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}a+90^\circ+162^\circ+90^\circ&=360^\circ\\a&=18^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Tangents from P below the circle and reflex central angle marked above O.
spec.mathematics: The reflex angle BOA is 205°; the lower interior central angle is its complement to 360°.

answer.worked:
The interior central angle is $360^\circ-205^\circ=155^\circ$. Each tangent is perpendicular to its contact radius.
$$\begin{aligned}a+90^\circ+155^\circ+90^\circ&=360^\circ\\a&=25^\circ\end{aligned}$$
